crossRefs.note: Hakkoz became the father of Anub, Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
crossRefs.keyword: as a consequent without an antecedent

people.name: Aharhel
people.line: Son of Harum, from the tribe of Judah

people.name: Anub
people.line: Son of Coz, descendant of Judah

translations.web: Hakkoz became the father of Anub, Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
translations.bsb: and Koz, who was the father of Anub and Zobebah and of the clans of Aharhel son of Harum.
translations.kjv: And Coz begat Anub, and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
translations.asv: And Hakkoz begat Anub, and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
